items.title: Robert Lewis Interview 1959-11-10
items.q: Well, I guess I was one of his pupils, but not for very long.

ctx.x: I understand you were one of the two pupils that Sidney Bechet had, and I hope you could tell us a little bit about your lessons with him and your experiences with Sidney.

Well, I guess I was one of his pupils, but not for very long. I was going to school at the time, and of course he was traveling a great deal. And I suppose I took no more than eight lessons in total from him.
